Rewrite `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AdminLayout.tsx` with the following specific improvements. Do NOT change the nav items or routing logic. This is a production-grade fix only — no extra features. **Current issues to fix:** 1. **Active nav item** — No left accent bar indicator. Add a `` absolutely positioned: `absolute left-0 top-1.5 bottom-1.5 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary` inside each active ``. The `` must have `relative` class. 2. **Sidebar footer user card** — Currently just static display of avatar + name. Replace with a `DropdownMenu` trigger button (the whole user card row is the trigger). When expanded, show avatar + name + role + `ChevronsUpDown` icon. When collapsed, show only avatar (centered). The dropdown opens upward (`side="top"`), contains: profile name+email header block, then Settings item → navigate("/settings"), View App item → navigate("/dashboard"), separator, Log out item (destructive red). No separate collapse button in footer anymore. 3. **Collapse toggle** — Move it INTO the sidebar header (the `h-14` header bar), as a small icon-only button on the right side of the logo area. `ChevronLeft` when expanded, `ChevronRight` when collapsed. When collapsed, the header just shows the icon centered with no collapse button visible (the icon IS the toggle in that case — add it as a separate button that shows only when collapsed, positioned after the logo icon). Actually: when expanded → show logo + name + collapse button (ChevronLeft) on the right. When collapsed → show only the logo icon centered (clicking the ChevronRight that's... hmm). Better: ALWAYS show a small collapse button on the right of the header that's `ChevronLeft` when expanded, `ChevronRight` when collapsed. When collapsed, the header has the logo centered AND the collapse button on the far right (even if tiny space). 4. **Admin topbar right button (clickability fix)** — The current trigger button lacks visual affordance. Make it: `type="button"` explicitly, add `border border-transparent hover:border-border/60 hover:bg-muted/50` classes, add `ChevronDown` icon with `hidden sm:block h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60`, add `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring`, increase padding to `px-2.5 py-1.5`, increase avatar size to `h-7 w-7`. 5. **Topbar dropdown content** — Make it wider (`w-56`), use `p-0` and structured sections like the user sidebar TopBar: identity header (avatar + name + email), navigation group, separator, logout. 6. **Fix invalid Tailwind class** — `bg-primary/8` is not valid. Replace with `bg-primary/10`. 7. **Breadcrumb** — Replace the plain text `/` separator with a `ChevronRight` icon (`h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/40`). Change `bg-white/80` header to `bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-sm`. **Imports needed:** Add `ChevronDown`, `ChevronsUpDown`, `ExternalLink` from lucide-react. Keep all existing imports. **The full rewritten file must:** - Keep all 9 nav items (Dashboard, Users, Scans, Billing, System, Feature Flags, Integrations, Support, Audit Log) - Keep the "Back to App" link with ArrowLeft - Keep the AdminNavItem interface and NAV_ITEMS const - Keep the isActive, handleLogout, displayName, initials logic unchanged - Keep the main content area: `
` - Add `DropdownMenuLabel` to the imports from `@/components/ui/dropdown-menu` if not already there Write the complete file. No placeholders. Production-ready.

Build passes with zero errors. Here is a summary of every change made in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AdminLayout.tsx`:

**Imports added:** `ChevronDown`, `ChevronsUpDown`, `ExternalLink`, `DropdownMenuLabel` (the last one is imported but available for future use without a re-edit).

**Fix 1 — Active nav accent bar:** Each active `<Link>` now has `relative` class and contains `<span className="absolute left-0 top-1.5 bottom-1.5 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />` rendered only when `active === true`.

**Fix 2 — Sidebar footer user card:** Replaced the static display with a `DropdownMenu`. The trigger button shows avatar + name + role + `ChevronsUpDown` when expanded, avatar only when collapsed. The dropdown opens `side="top"`, has a structured identity header (avatar + full name + email), then Settings and View App items, a separator, and a destructive Log out item. The separate collapse button in the footer is gone.

**Fix 3 — Collapse toggle in header:** The toggle moved into the `h-14` header bar. When expanded: logo + name on the left, `ChevronLeft` button on the right. When collapsed: logo icon + `ChevronRight` button side by side. A shared `toggleCollapsed` function handles the sessionStorage persistence.

**Fix 4 — Topbar trigger button:** Now has `type="button"`, `border border-transparent hover:border-border/60 hover:bg-muted/50`, `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring`, padding `px-2.5 py-1.5`, avatar `h-7 w-7`, and `ChevronDown` icon (`hidden sm:block h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60`).

**Fix 5 — Topbar dropdown:** Now `w-56 p-0` with the same structured layout as the sidebar dropdown: identity header block, navigation group with Settings and View App, separator, destructive Log out.

**Fix 6 — Invalid Tailwind class:** Both occurrences of `bg-primary/8` replaced with `bg-primary/10`.

**Fix 7 — Breadcrumb and header background:** The `/` text separator replaced with `<ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/40" />`. The header `bg-white/80` replaced with `bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-sm`.
